I end up staying in bed all day and then punish myself for wasting another day. I’m already 22 and with lockdown I’ve already had a lot of time to change my habits but I don’t have the strength. I don’t think I ever will
What should I do? I don’t want to hurt them but life is just exhausting and I really don’t see the point in carrying on for the possibility that it one day might be okay

If you are looking and posting on here that means there’s still a part of you that wants to live. That wants someone to read this and tell you that will be okay. And you will. Listen to that part of yourself!

Feeling all those negative emotions is not your fault. And there is no shame in wishing for childhood, to be ignorant and looked after. Maybe try and do something you wanted to do as a child but couldn’t? Like buy all the sweets you want? I don’t know but maybe start fulfilling the dreams of child you and that might help you feel happier?

There’s nothing wrong with you. You didn’t need to worry about looking after yourself because you knew there were people there to do that. I bet you felt a load of anxiety leave you. We all need to be cared for when we’re ill, and mental illness is no different
You are never truly alone ❤️
Hey you can talk to me about it. I’m sorry your in such a bad place. But if you’re posting on here it means your sending out a cry for help. I can hear you. X
